statement: Evaluate $\displaystyle\int_0^1 x^2 e^x\,dx$ using integration by parts.
solution:
Integrate by parts with $u=x^2$, $dv=e^x\,dx$ (so $du=2x\,dx$, $v=e^x$):
$$\int_0^1 x^2 e^x\,dx = \Bigl[x^2 e^x\Bigr]_0^1 - \int_0^1 2x e^x\,dx = e - 2\int_0^1 x e^x\,dx.$$
Now $\int x e^x\,dx = x e^x - e^x$ (again by parts), so
$$\int_0^1 x e^x\,dx = \Bigl[x e^x - e^x\Bigr]_0^1 = (e-e) - (0-1) = 1.$$
Therefore
$$\int_0^1 x^2 e^x\,dx = e - 2(1) = e-2.$$

int_0^1 x e^x dx = 1, so the answer is e-2.
